headline: A ground stop is holding flights into Newark.

items.text: The FAA has a ground stop in effect for flights into Newark until 8:00 PM ET, because of heavy traffic. Those flights are held at their departure airports, and the FAA rates the chance of an extension as medium.
Newark is the lowest of the seven United hubs reporting, with 71% of departures so far today leaving within 30 minutes of schedule.
Radio heard on Newark air traffic control frequencies at 5:29 PM ET included "GLS approach out of service", according to a model-written summary that can contain mistakes.
Weather is not affecting operations at any of the 9 United hubs with a current report, and the other hubs are running normally.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Newark, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
